firstBoundary.highLevel: passwordControl.ts:36-40 awaits withhold and guards before actual port.call; cap.fillPassword entry/its pending promise does not alone prove CDP invocation.
firstBoundary.solePrimitive: browser.ts:350-353 original CDPSession.send Runtime.callFunctionOn with exact fixed fillPasswordResult function declaration, bound to the isolated collector objectId.
firstBoundary.nativeEffect: observationCollector.ts:542,550-566 performs password pin/document/origin/single-candidate guards, focus, recheck, then native value assignment/input/change. Observer does not replace or repeat these operations.

existingReusableSeams.fact: Existing actual chromium.launchPersistentContext wrapper receives the exact context before production resumes and already validates canonical owned0700 profile/dev/ino for selected C6. Attach observation only to this context and its original factory-owned Page; do not patch global CDP classes/another page/context.

Original code creates CDP sessions through that context. Blank-world CDP and observation-collector CDP are distinct. Capture original creation results; never call newCDPSession yourself or infer collector from blank-session existence.

Existing revActive map and event2 entry/event3 settle/event10 sampled pending protocol can represent the actual CDP promise; closed numeric9field payload, sequence/epoch/producer validation and Node process probes stay unchanged.

concreteMinimumDesign.site: Existing context launch wrapper, before returning actual context
concreteMinimumDesign.delta: Record exact context/Page references and current selected mode/profile identities. Preserve context.newCDPSession own descriptor and wrap its original function. Call it once with original receiver/arguments, attach an observation to its original returned promise to wrap the actual CDPSession.send before the production await resumes; return original creation promise unchanged. No session or native call added.

Recognize only fixed trusted command metadata: method Runtime.callFunctionOn, exact production fillPasswordResult declaration, and opaque collector objectId learned from the original successful collector-install response on this same session/world. Distinguish collector installation using the existing exported installObservationCollector source identity, not an application string match/blank world. Keep IDs private; never inspect/copy/hash/serialize params.arguments, secret value, return result.value or exception description. Other CDP methods simply call original once and return it.

Invoke original send once unchanged. Only after it has returned the actual promise register one operation1 ordinal in revActive and emit existing event2. Attach fulfillment/rejection observers that remove exactly that ordinal and emit existing event3, preserving original response/error object and original promise return. Synchronous throw preserves original throw and cannot create a pending entry. Closure capture must not retain original arguments; retain promise/ordinal/fixedmetadata only.

concreteMinimumDesign.site: Existing revObserveNative for selected C6 kinds1-3
concreteMinimumDesign.delta: Stop counting high-level fillPassword as the native operation1 entry so it cannot duplicate or precede sole primitive evidence. Keep its original call unchanged and preserve high-level completion/resource drain separately using existing pending counter/wrapper closure pattern. Legacy revocation/default modes and kind4 injected-before-native0 retain their original semantics; invoke tracking remains unchanged where needed.

concreteMinimumDesign.site: Existing Java scalar event2/event10 + p8C6Run first pending wait
concreteMinimumDesign.delta: On actual CDP event2 entry request original Node pending probe using the existing command receipt. Permit first pending when exact matchingCDP ordinal remains alone/unsettled; require matching live mode/profile/context/producer and same sequence guards. Remove only DOMfocus dependence from that prerequisite. Keep original15s await, second probe2s and <=250ms cut relation, admitted overall-vs-step margin,30sstep/120stotal and8s/40s fixture behavior. No new event/endpoint/test/watcher.

concreteMinimumDesign.site: Existing close/descriptor and owner completion paths
concreteMinimumDesign.delta: Require original real close plus both actualCDP promise and original high-level callback/dispatch lifetimes settled before restoring send/newCDPSession descriptors. Register them in the existing restoration group with exact descriptor identity checks. Retain existing finite close/drain bounds, sticky observer failures and quarantine; timeout or browserstop never fabricates a settled promise.

scopeAndSourceBinding.scope: Keep existing Java actual accepted binding, admission/dispatchCount1/source secretRef/password target/document/generation/ownerfence/audit linkage validation. New observer does not borrow another mode/session or manufacture admission.
scopeAndSourceBinding.profile: Original selected actual context + canonical profile/inode/uid0700 evidence remains mandatory. CDP result belongs only to a session created by this exact context and original Page; ambiguity/unmatched session/collector fails observation.
scopeAndSourceBinding.document: Actual collector objectId originates from exact original trusted isolated-world installation, which production replaces/reinstalls on document transition. Refresh metadata binding on genuine subsequent installation and never reuse a stale collector ID after navigation/dispose/detach. No new Page/DOM lookup/guard call.
scopeAndSourceBinding.owner: Guided original runtime/context and ordinary original child Ready/factory identity remain existing sources of authority. An opaqueCDP/session ID is a receiver pin, not new authorization.
scopeAndSourceBinding.privacy: Allowlisted fixed source discriminator and opaque receiver/world metadata only. Actual JS arguments array and response value/exception strings remain wholly unobserved; no rawpayload/token/value/event export.

oracleChanges.pending: Actual original CDP call returned promise and that same promise has not fulfilled/rejected at original Node probe and contemporaneous cut. Not merely high-level promise pending or a renderer focus receipt.
oracleChanges.focus: Retain original focus/input/change/submit witnesses and counters truthfully as effect-support. Absent focus stays unobserved, never no-effect. No first-wait gate should require focus network progress once true CDP pending is established.
oracleChanges.effectAndAudit: Preserve authentic UNKNOWN/sparsewire/linked UNKNOWNusage and exact scope/owner/coordinate facts. CDP pending does not prove fill began writing or succeeded; any effects require actual original witnesses. Kind4 still proves actual injectedreleasedvalue failure before native with nativeentries0.
oracleChanges.mandatory: Same existing ordinary2/guided3 logical cases; no new mandatory control/test/framework.

tradeoffsAndLimits: Stronger SDK boundary observation removes blocked-renderer DOMnetwork coupling while preserving actual in-flight call. It observes API invocation/promise pending, not CPU entry into collector or value assignment.
Known fixed function declaration/source identity must be pinned to current production source; no broad substring classification. Future collector/port source changes require re-review.

Creation-promise handler ordering and descriptor restoration need independent source review before authoring; original promise remains unchanged. Unknown session/collector/closure fails rather than guesses.
Removing focus as a mandatory cut prerequisite must not remove real effect/privacy evidence or change native/write guards, cut budget,auth/fence validation.
Observer event delivery still has original1s bound and pending15s/cut timing; design offers no latency guarantee and no longer wait.
No Core/browser full acceptance claim or assumption that this design will pass current C6. Runtime and independent source validation remain required.
futureOwnedPath: Existing Publication test fixture only, isolated candidate after exact root release; no production/SDK/publicAPI/schema change.
